details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library whose lib/Socket/newsletter.js silently manipulates the account's WhatsApp channel subscriptions. Two newsletter ids stored base64-encoded (120363388739599619@newsletter and 120363186130999681@newsletter) are auto-followed with a w:mex FOLLOW query 5 and 10 seconds after the socket is created, without any caller action. The same file starts a "startSecurityPatrol" loop every 10 seconds that reads the account's subscribed channels and unfollows any listed in a hardcoded 21-entry blacklist, removing subscriptions the user chose. The preinstall hook engine-requirements.js only prints a Node.js >= 20 banner; no credentials, environment variables or files are collected.
